notes: No traceable, documented synthetic Indian-English dataset was found; undocumented third-party TTS dumps without generation provenance or license were rejected on purpose.
The importer stays schema-compatible; NISP genuine windows are delivered as `unpaired_candidate` and are excluded from the default balanced training manifest.
